item: Row 288 batch 1: 100 test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 131 bare create_engine calls in 100 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so those tests run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings instead of SQLite's defaults; all 1530 tests in them pass unchanged. The helper now defaults to an in-memory database, passes other keyword arguments to create_engine unchanged, and takes one named override, busy_timeout_ms, defaulting to the app's 30000 (Plan's ruling): test_backup_snapshot.py provokes a busy database on purpose and passes busy_timeout_ms=50, where staying bare would have dropped every other app pragma. Two new tests pin the helper's default to the busy timeout measured from the app's own connect listener and show the override changes no other pragma. The ratchet ceiling goes from 872 to 741 calls in 540 files. Test-only, no release line.
